app.name: Dauys-Foto
app.tagline: Learn photo editing with your voice

auth.loginLead: Log in to get back to your photos.
auth.registerLead: Tell us your name, then pick a username and a password.
auth.toLogin: Already have an account? Log in

errors.username_taken: That username is taken. Try another one.
errors.username_invalid: Use only letters, numbers, dots or dashes in the username.
errors.passwords_differ: The passwords don't match. Try once more.
errors.password_short: The password needs at least 6 characters.
errors.login_failed: The username or password didn't match. Check them and try again.
errors.network: Couldn't reach the server. Check that the backend is running.
errors.upload_failed: That file couldn't be uploaded. Try a different picture.
errors.save_failed: The photo wasn't saved on the server, but you can still download it.
errors.chat_failed: The chat message didn't go through. The change to the photo is kept.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

home.title: My photos
home.lead: Pick a photo and change it with your voice.

editor.freeMode: Free mode: say any command you like.

voice.idle: Press the microphone and say a command
voice.unclear: I couldn't catch a command. Please say it again.
voice.noSpeech: No voice came through. Press the microphone and try again.
voice.micBlocked: The microphone is blocked. Allow it in the browser, or use the buttons below.
voice.offline: Speech recognition isn't available right now. The buttons below still work.
voice.unsupported: This browser can't use the microphone. Use the buttons below.
